Introduction

DNA is a five-member co-ed collaborative project group under Na Entertainment. Consisting of members from DUSTIN and NWH:I, they made their debut on September 3, 2025 with the digital single "Change the World".

Their group name is an abbreviation for DUSTIN & NWH:I Assemble.
